episodes.154212: A squall line which formed along an advancing surface cold front produced strong wind gusts, severe hail, and an EF-1 Tornado in Texas City, TX which resulted in damage to homes and businesses.
episodes.155462: An isolated storm produced quarter sized hail in Milam County. The storms had formed along and ahead of a cold front moving through the area.

events.narrative: Quarter sized hail was reported northeast of Milano.
Strong wind gusts caused tree damage in Brazoria County, resulting in trees blocking roads.
Severe hail (1 in.) was observed by a member of the public as a squall line moved through Brazoria County.
